spec.description:
Cancel a particular open order (or set of open orders sharing a `userref`) by `txid`, `userref` or `cl_ord_id`.

**API Key Permissions Required:** `Orders and trades - Create & modify orders` or `Orders and trades - Cancel & close orders`

request.title: CancelOrderRequest
request.description: Parameters identifying the order(s) to cancel.

txid.description: Kraken order identifier (txid), or a user reference (userref) to cancel every order sharing it.

cl_ord_id.description: An alphanumeric client order identifier which uniquely identifies an open order for this client.

response.title: OrderCancelledFrame
response.description: Wire frame; the generated method returns `result`.

error.description: Wire envelope field; see the core.

pending.description: If true, orders are pending cancellation.

notes: `nonce` is dropped from the request body -- transport-injected by the client core (authed_request), never a caller-supplied parameter.
`txid` converted from upstream's `oneOf: [string, integer]` to `anyOf` per spec-authoring rule 4.

Upstream's own request `example` includes a `pair` field that is not declared anywhere in the schema's `properties` (likely copy-pasted from AddOrder's example) -- omitted here since it isn't documented.
Neither `txid` nor `cl_ord_id` is marked required despite the description implying one must be given -- upstream's `required` list holds only `nonce`, so nothing remains required after dropping it.
